pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   D. Say Eid has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   B. Say Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   B. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

13. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
14. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
